decisions.reason: The candidate already reflects the single-board architecture and removal of interboard connectors. The source only relaxes legacy board-placement constraints and does not change the required external sensor connectors or their assembly style.

Removing the legacy main-board form-factor constraint does not change the backlight circuit, supply, control, or component requirements. The surrounding context still separately constrains display-connector grouping.
The SPS30 interface is already scoped to the integrated board, and the source does not change its connector, pinout, voltage, logic-level, or level-shifting requirements.
